title: M1 (CH263) J3 read-out resolution fetch (MEASUREMENT_M1_CH263.md 9.4): Gamma /markets?id= in batches of 50 with closed=true, a second pass without the filter for ids not returned, up to 3 attempts per batch at least 1 h apart, parse_outcome at the pinned calibration.py; on or after READOUT_UTC
expected_value: the resolution classes of 8.1 for every unit (resolved, split, pending, not_found, unavailable) for the analysis; about 100-400 requests
notes: DRAFT (not in jobs/). Refuses before READOUT_UTC (2027-01-15T00:00Z, or the slid date in the registration commit), without the J2 manifest, and over an existing read-out. The 1 h gap between attempts is slept inside the job (timeout 8 h covers 2 passes x 2 gaps). The no-retry-at-once case is the only way a batch becomes unavailable (fetch). If the slide rule moved the dates, edit not_before in the registration commit only. Code: backend/scripts/run_m1.py with astrolabe/research_lab/m1_spec.py, m1_extract.py, m1_readout.py, m1_analysis.py and the imported m1_j0.py (code_sha in the unit lines); pins checked at start (exit 3 with expected and actual values on a mismatch, exit 2 on a declared refusal).
